test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MEAL' is written as 'BMNF' and 'FOOD' is written as 'PEGP'. How will 'FARE' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet are as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'MEAL' is written as 'BMNF' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9784e891b55133fdcd2da6e35a1be546be6b39c4ff775fe01bb92b854741471e.png] 

'FOOD' is written as 'PEGP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81ab0d70688f6b7227d6e3559c898c0b0656bfe4ce5748dc20b11d5cd8aec4c2.png] 

Similarly, 'FARE' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f2ce3abc36f867ef0446de68ea0b3e9d6aa6c40fdab5800684d60d14459962d.png] 

Hence, **'option 2'** is the correct answer.
